records.title: Under One Aurora
records.selection: Featured artist, recommended by the Fairbanks Region III supervisor

story.en: Alaska's 2026 I Voted stickers carry art by Anchorage artist Amanda Rose Warren, the Division of Elections' featured artist this year. Her "Under One Aurora" designs show five animals for the state's five regions (a humpback whale, moose, fox, musk ox and bear) under the same aurora, with the American and Alaska flags.
story.es: Los stickers de I Voted de Alaska para 2026 llevan arte de Amanda Rose Warren, artista de Anchorage y la artista invitada de la División de Elecciones este año. Sus diseños "Under One Aurora" muestran cinco animales por las cinco regiones del estado (una ballena jorobada, un alce, un zorro, un buey almizclero y un oso) bajo la misma aurora, con las banderas de Estados Unidos y de Alaska.
story.quote: Additionally, her artwork will be featured on the Division of Elections' "I Voted" stickers for the 2026 election.

story.en: For the November 3, 2026 general election, Alabama's Secretary of State released newly designed America 250 I Voted stickers, marking the country's 250th anniversary.
story.es: Para la elección general del 3 de noviembre de 2026, la Secretaría de Estado de Alabama sacó stickers de I Voted con un diseño nuevo de America 250, por los 250 años del país.
story.quote: Wes Allen, Alabama's Secretary of State is announcing the release of newly designed America 250 "I Voted" stickers

records.title: Vote in the Desert
records.selection: County's first youth and adult contests; four winning designs

story.en: Maricopa County held its first I Voted sticker contests in 2024 and used four winning designs that year. One was "Vote in the Desert" by Jake, a 17-year-old junior at Brophy College Preparatory in Phoenix.
story.es: El condado de Maricopa hizo sus primeros concursos de stickers de I Voted en 2024 y usó cuatro diseños ganadores ese año. Uno fue "Vote in the Desert", de Jake, un estudiante de 17 años de Brophy College Preparatory en Phoenix.
story.quote: These designs will be utilized in Maricopa County's upcoming July 30 primary and November 5 general election.

distribution.en: In Pima County, early voters got their own sticker. In 2022 the Recorder's Office made it trilingual: "I voted" in English, "A:ñi 'ant wodalt" in Tohono O'odham and "Yo Voté" in Spanish, a nod to the Tohono O'odham Nation's ancestral homelands. It went to early voters by mail and in person. Election Day voters got the standard oval sticker.
distribution.quote: Pima County's new Early Voting Sticker is tri-lingual! The sticker reads "I voted" in English, "A:ñi 'ant wodalt" in Tohono O'odham and "Yo Voté" in Spanish. ... These stickers are exclusively available for Early Voters who cast an Early Ballot via mail or in person at any of the Recorder's 15 Early Voting Sites. Those who vote in person on Election Day will receive the standard oval "I Voted" sticker.

records.title: Six student-designed I Voted stickers
records.office: Santa Clara County Registrar of Voters
records.selection: Student contest, public vote

story.en: Santa Clara County's first I Voted sticker contest drew 203 student designs, and more than 10,000 public votes picked six winners. More than one million vote-by-mail packets for November 3 include one of the six, and all six are handed out at the county's Vote Centers.
story.es: El primer concurso de stickers I Voted del condado de Santa Clara recibió 203 diseños de estudiantes, y más de 10,000 votos del público eligieron seis ganadores. Más de un millón de paquetes de voto por correo para el 3 de noviembre traen uno de los seis, y los seis se reparten en los centros de votación (Vote Centers) del condado.
story.quote: The ROV received 203 submissions and selected 30 finalists for a public online vote. More than 10,000 votes were cast to help select the winning designs. ... Beginning in October, more than one million registered voters will receive one of the six winning stickers in their Vote by Mail packets for the November 3rd General Election. All six designs will also be available to voters casting their ballots in person at Santa Clara County Vote Centers.

records.selection: Student design contest

distribution.en: In San Luis Obispo County, yes. The county's 2026 student-designed stickers are handed out at both of its elections offices, where you can vote early, and at polling locations during the November election.
distribution.quote: The winning designs will be printed and distributed at both SLO County Elections Offices and at polling locations during the June and November 2026 elections.

distribution.en: Look in your ballot packet. In San Diego County, the November 3 packet includes an "I Voted" sticker with the voting instructions and the two-card ballot. In another county? Check your own ballot packet.
distribution.quote: The official ballot packet will include voting instructions, a two-card ballot and an "I Voted" sticker.

records.title: High school I Voted digital sticker contest
records.selection: High school contest; winner picked by popular vote

story.en: Colorado's Secretary of State runs a digital "I Voted" sticker contest for high school students. The 2026 winner is Halle, a senior at Pine Creek High School in Colorado Springs. Her design shows Blucifer, the blue mustang sculpture by Luis A. Jimenez, Jr. outside Denver International Airport.
story.es: La Secretaría de Estado de Colorado organiza un concurso de stickers digitales de "I Voted" para estudiantes de preparatoria. La ganadora de 2026 es Halle, estudiante de último año en Pine Creek High School, en Colorado Springs. Su diseño muestra a Blucifer, la escultura del mustang azul de Luis A. Jimenez, Jr. que está afuera del Aeropuerto Internacional de Denver.
story.quote: Today, Secretary of State Jena Griswold announced Pine Creek High School Senior Halle G. as the winner of Colorado's 2026 "I Voted" Digital Sticker Design Contest.

distribution.en: In Garfield County, yes, while supplies last: a limited special edition "I Voted" sticker for the nation's 250th and Colorado's 150th anniversaries is at ballot drop boxes and vote centers.
distribution.quote: available at ballot drop boxes and vote centers while supplies last

distribution.en: Sign up for BallotTrax. Once your ballot is accepted, it sends you the 2026 Blucifer "I Voted" digital sticker to share.
distribution.quote: Voters who get updates via BallotTrax will receive this special Blucifer 'I Voted' digital sticker after their ballot has been accepted.

records.title: I Voted Today
records.office: Connecticut registrars of voters (state law, chapter 146)

story.en: For the 2020 election, the 100th anniversary of the 19th Amendment, Connecticut's Secretary of the State put out "I Voted" stickers honoring Connecticut women who fought for the vote. Wilton designer Pamela Hovland started the project, and the stickers won a 2020 U.S. Election Assistance Commission award. You can still download them from the Secretary of the State's site.
story.es: Para la elección de 2020, en el centenario de la Enmienda 19, la Secretaría del Estado de Connecticut sacó stickers de "I Voted" en honor a las mujeres de Connecticut que lucharon por el voto. La diseñadora Pamela Hovland, de Wilton, inició el proyecto, y los stickers ganaron un premio de la Comisión de Asistencia Electoral de EE. UU. (U.S. Election Assistance Commission) en 2020. Todavía puedes descargarlos del sitio de la Secretaría del Estado.
story.quote: Connecticut Secretary of the State Denise Merrill announced today that Connecticut’s Commemorative Suffragist “I Voted” Stickers were named a 2020 Clearinghouse Award winner by the U.S. Election Assistance Commission for their depiction of Connecticut women who fought for women’s suffrage and voting rights. The project was initiated by Pamela Hovland, a Wilton resident, graphic designer, faculty member at Yale University and a long-time visual activist

distribution.en: Check your mail ballot packet. The DC Board of Elections lists an instruction sheet with an "I Voted" sticker as one of the items it should have.
distribution.quote: An Instruction Sheet with “I Voted” Sticker

records.title: Pink flamingo
records.selection: A seventh grader's design, from more than 175 student entries

story.en: Some Florida counties pick their stickers in student contests. In Sarasota County, a seventh grader's pink flamingo, chosen from more than 175 student entries, is the sticker for November 3, offered to everyone who votes by mail, early or on Election Day.
story.es: Algunos condados de Florida eligen sus stickers en concursos para estudiantes. En el condado de Sarasota, un flamenco rosa dibujado por un estudiante de séptimo grado, elegido entre más de 175 propuestas, es el sticker del 3 de noviembre, y se le ofrece a toda persona que vote por correo, por anticipado o el Día de las Elecciones.
story.quote: This year, a pink flamingo is at the center of the sticker, and I think the voters are going to love this design as much as they did the previous one.

distribution.en: In Sarasota County, yes. The Supervisor of Elections says anyone who votes by mail will be offered the county's 2026 "I Voted" sticker, the pink flamingo design. Ask the Supervisor of Elections office how to get yours.
distribution.quote: Anyone who votes by mail (absentee), early in-person or on election day will be offered an “I Voted” sticker.

records.selection: County design contest

distribution.en: In Clay County, yes. The winning design from the county's student sticker contest is handed out during early voting and on Election Day in 2026.
distribution.quote: One original sticker design will be chosen and reproduced for distribution during Early Voting and Election Day for both the Primary and General Elections in 2026.

story.en: Georgia has a new statewide "I Voted" sticker for 2026, designed by Georgia artist Steve Penley. The Secretary of State printed five million and is sending them to all 159 counties.
story.es: Georgia tiene un nuevo sticker estatal de "I Voted" para 2026, diseñado por el artista georgiano Steve Penley. La Secretaría de Estado imprimió cinco millones y los está enviando a los 159 condados.
story.quote: Five million stickers featuring the unique design have been printed and will be distributed to all 159 counties across Georgia.

distribution.en: Yes. The Secretary of State said voters could get the 2026 sticker starting the first day of early voting, October 13.
distribution.quote: Voters can get the stickers when early voting starts on October 13.

records.title: Virtual I Voted sticker
records.selection: Download after your ballot is accepted for counting

story.en: Hawaii tied its sticker to ballot tracking. In 2022, once your ballot was accepted for counting, you could download a virtual "I Voted" sticker.
story.es: Hawaii unió su sticker al seguimiento de boletas. En 2022, cuando aceptaban tu boleta para contarla, podías descargar un sticker virtual de "I Voted".
story.quote: “Once your ballot has been accepted for counting, voters can also download their virtual ‘I Voted’ sticker,” he added.

records.title: County contest stickers; I Voted After Dark for evening early voters
records.selection: County design contest

story.en: In Johnson County, people who vote early after 5 p.m. during the Auditor's Voting After Dark evening hours get a special I Voted After Dark sticker. The evening hours run at the Auditor's Office and the Iowa City Public Library through October 28.
story.es: En el condado de Johnson, quienes votan por anticipado después de las 5 p. m., durante el horario nocturno Voting After Dark de la oficina del Auditor, reciben un sticker especial I Voted After Dark. El horario nocturno es en la oficina del Auditor y en la Biblioteca Pública de Iowa City hasta el 28 de octubre.
story.quote: Special "I Voted After Dark" stickers will be available only after 5:00 PM.

distribution.en: In Johnson County, yes. The county's 2026 "I Voted" stickers, chosen in its design contest, are handed out during early voting and on Election Day.
distribution.quote: The winning designs will become the official stickers distributed during early voting and on Election Day in 2026 and 2027.

story.en: Idaho's own voting guide ends with a sticker: after you turn in your ballot, grab an I Voted sticker and wear it proudly.
story.es: La propia guía para votar de Idaho termina con un sticker: después de entregar tu boleta, toma un sticker de I Voted y llévalo con orgullo.
story.quote: Grab an “I Voted” sticker and wear it proudly!

story.en: In Lake County, students designed the 2026 sticker. The County Clerk's contest asked K to 12 students for red, white and blue designs on the theme "Lake County Votes!" The grand prize design was to be printed as the official 2026 I Voted sticker at polling places across the county.
story.es: En el condado de Lake, estudiantes diseñaron el sticker de 2026. El concurso de la secretaría del condado (County Clerk) pidió a estudiantes de kínder a 12.º grado diseños en rojo, blanco y azul con el tema "Lake County Votes!" El diseño ganador del gran premio se iba a imprimir como el sticker oficial de I Voted de 2026 en los lugares de votación de todo el condado.
story.quote: One Grand Prize Winner will also receive a $125 gift card and have their design printed and distributed as the official 2026 "I Voted" sticker at polling places across Lake County! Theme: "Lake County Votes!" Must use: Red, White, and Blue with the hashtag #lakecountyvotes

distribution.en: In Champaign County, yes. The clerk's early voting steps end with taking an "I Voted" sticker once your ballot is cast.
distribution.quote: Take an "I Voted" sticker and you're done!

records.selection: Student contest, grades K-12, first place in each grade group

story.en: In 2024 the Indiana Secretary of State held an I Voted sticker contest for students in kindergarten through 12th grade. The first-place design from each grade group was chosen for the stickers handed out on Election Day, November 5, 2024.
story.es: En 2024, la Secretaría de Estado de Indiana organizó un concurso de stickers de I Voted para estudiantes de kínder a 12.º grado. El diseño ganador de cada grupo de grados se eligió para los stickers que se repartieron el Día de las Elecciones, el 5 de noviembre de 2024.
story.quote: will be featured on stickers distributed to voters on Election Day, November 5.

story.en: Sedgwick County's 2026 I Voted sticker is a picture of Kansas: a Western Meadowlark, a barn, wheat, a sunflower, the state motto "Ad Astra Per Aspera" and a road across the prairie to the State Capitol. Rylin, a sophomore at Maize South High School, drew it. Penelope, a third grader at Colwich Elementary, drew the county's first Future Voter sticker, an American Buffalo in a field of sunflowers. Community judges picked them in the county's student design contest, from 305 and 163 entries. Voters get them at the polls.
story.es: El sticker de I Voted 2026 del condado de Sedgwick es una imagen de Kansas: un pradero occidental (Western Meadowlark), un granero, trigo, un girasol, el lema del estado "Ad Astra Per Aspera" y un camino por la pradera hasta el Capitolio del estado. Lo dibujó Rylin, estudiante de segundo año de Maize South High School. Penelope, estudiante de tercer grado de Colwich Elementary, dibujó el primer sticker de Future Voter del condado: un bisonte americano (American Buffalo) en un campo de girasoles. Un jurado de la comunidad los eligió en el concurso de diseño para estudiantes del condado, entre 305 y 163 propuestas, respectivamente. Los votantes los reciben en su lugar de votación.
story.quote: Rylin, a sophomore at Maize South High School, won the contest for the “I Voted” sticker ... including the state bird of Kansas ... the Western Meadowlark, a barn, grain bin, airplane, wheat stalk, sunflower, the state motto ... “Ad Astra Per Aspera,” and a road leading through a prairie to the Kansas State Capitol building. Penelope, a third-grade student at Colwich Elementary, is the winner of the first “Future Voter” sticker contest. Her design features an American Buffalo ... in a field of sunflowers ... wear stickers they get at the polls ... A panel of judges from the community picked the winning artwork from 305 “I Voted” sticker entries and 163 “Future Voter” designs

records.selection: County contest

distribution.quote: wear stickers they get at the polls or in an advance by mail ballot

records.title: 2026 I voted sticker contest
records.selection: Third annual contest for K-12 students

story.en: Kentucky's 2026 I voted sticker is a smiling sun over rolling Kentucky pasture with a blue outline of the state, drawn by Ryker, a student at Bush Elementary in Laurel County. Voters picked it from the finalists with more than 3,500 ballots at the Kentucky State Fair. Laurel County gets the stickers from the Secretary of State's Office, and other county clerks can request them for November, so not every polling place will have one.
story.es: El sticker "I Voted" de Kentucky para 2026 es un sol sonriente sobre los pastizales de Kentucky con el contorno del estado en azul. Lo dibujó Ryker, estudiante de la escuela primaria Bush en el condado de Laurel. Los votantes lo eligieron entre los finalistas con más de 3,500 votos en la Feria Estatal de Kentucky. El condado de Laurel recibe los stickers de la Secretaría de Estado, y los secretarios de otros condados pueden pedirlos para noviembre, así que no todos los lugares de votación los tendrán.
story.quote: Laurel County will receive "I Voted" stickers featuring Ryker's design from the Secretary of State's Office. Other county clerks may request the stickers to provide to voters during the November election.

records.title: 2026 I voted sticker, artist series
records.selection: Artist series (sixth sticker since 2016)

story.en: Louisiana's 2026 I voted sticker has art by New Orleans artist Terrance Osborne. He said he pictured what Louisiana would look like if you could see its sound. It's the state's sixth I voted sticker and the fifth Louisiana artist in a series that started in 2016 with George Rodrigue's Blue Dog.
story.es: El sticker de I voted de Louisiana para 2026 tiene arte de Terrance Osborne, artista de New Orleans. Él dijo que imaginó cómo se vería Louisiana si se pudiera ver su sonido. Es el sexto sticker de I voted del estado y el quinto artista de Louisiana en una serie que empezó en 2016 con el Blue Dog de George Rodrigue.
story.quote: The artwork for this year’s sticker was created by New Orleans artist Terrance Osborne, who also attended the unveiling. Osborne said that his inspiration for the art was the imagery of what Louisiana would look like if you could see its sound. “Today’s unveiling marks Louisiana’s 6th ‘I Voted’ sticker and the 5th Louisiana artist featured as part of the series,” Secretary Landry said.

records.title: Four young artists' 2026 I Voted designs
records.selection: Youth contest, chosen by the Board of Registrars

story.en: In Middleborough, four young artists, Nolan, Abby, Calleigh and Colette, won the Town Clerk's 2026 I Voted sticker contest. The Board of Registrars picked their designs, and voters get them in November.
story.es: En Middleborough, cuatro artistas jóvenes, Nolan, Abby, Calleigh y Colette, ganaron el concurso de stickers I Voted 2026 de la oficina del secretario municipal (Town Clerk). La junta de registradores eligió sus diseños, y los votantes los reciben en noviembre.
story.quote: After carefully reviewing all entries, the Board of Registrars selected the winning designs that will be proudly distributed to voters during the November election.

records.title: Printable I Voted sticker for early and mail voters

distribution.en: In Somerville, the city's Elections Division posts an "I Voted" sticker image for early and mail voters to print at home or share online.
distribution.quote: Early and mail-in voters can have stickers too

records.title: Downloadable I Voted stickers, two in English and Spanish

story.en: The State Board of Elections has I voted sticker designs you can download, including two that say it in English and Spanish. One puts an oriole, a crab, a racehorse and a black-eyed Susan on the state flag. Another shows the Bay Bridge with a heron underneath.
story.es: La Junta Electoral del Estado tiene diseños de stickers de "I voted" que puedes descargar, incluidos dos que lo dicen en inglés y en español. Uno pone una oropéndola (oriole), un cangrejo, un caballo de carreras y una flor black-eyed Susan sobre la bandera del estado. Otro muestra el puente de la bahía (Bay Bridge) con una garza abajo.
story.quote: Click to download the I VOTED sticker you like!

story.en: For its 2020 student mock election, the Maine Secretary of State gave schools two printable "I Voted Today" sticker designs, made for Avery 5160 mailing labels.
story.es: Para su elección simulada estudiantil de 2020, la Secretaría de Estado de Maine les dio a las escuelas dos diseños de stickers "I Voted Today" para imprimir, hechos para etiquetas de correo Avery 5160.
story.quote: Pirnt your own "I Voted Today" stickers Choose from two, ready-to-print designs that utilize Avery 5160 mailing lables, 30 per sheet.

records.title: 2026 I Voted sticker contest winners
records.selection: Statewide contest; public vote on finalists; nine winners in three categories

story.en: Michigan's 2026 I Voted stickers come from a statewide contest run by the Michigan Department of State. More than 2,000 designs came in, the public voted on 30 finalists in each category, and nine designs won. In elementary and middle school, Aryana of Berrien Springs, Aleymi of Romulus and Naia of Detroit won with a "Let me sleep" sticker, a frog and a space bunny. In high school, Lenore of Saginaw, Ahmad of Dearborn Heights and Keirsten of Remus won with a Michigan license plate, a Michigan landscape and the Edmund Fitzgerald. In general entry, Maddie Tallman, Lisa Damesworth and Hilarie Williams won with "No yeah," Superman ice cream and construction barrels. Local election clerks can order the winning stickers for November, so ask yours which ones they hand out.
story.es: Los stickers de I Voted 2026 de Michigan salen de un concurso estatal del Departamento de Estado de Michigan (Michigan Department of State). Llegaron más de 2,000 diseños, el público votó entre 30 finalistas de cada categoría y ganaron nueve. En primaria y secundaria, ganaron Aryana de Berrien Springs, Aleymi de Romulus y Naia de Detroit, con un sticker "Let me sleep" (déjame dormir), una rana y un conejo espacial. En preparatoria, ganaron Lenore de Saginaw, Ahmad de Dearborn Heights y Keirsten de Remus, con una placa de Michigan, un paisaje de Michigan y el Edmund Fitzgerald. En la categoría general, ganaron Maddie Tallman, Lisa Damesworth y Hilarie Williams, con "No yeah", el helado Superman y barriles de construcción. Los secretarios locales (clerks) pueden pedir los stickers ganadores para noviembre, así que pregunta al tuyo cuáles reparten.
story.quote: From the 2,000+ designs received this year, the CSATF selected 30 in each category to move forward for public voting. ... Entry category: Elementary/middle (K-8), high school (9-12), or general entry (open to all Michiganders). ... Finalists were selected via online voting open to the public. ... Winning stickers will be available for election clerks to order for the November election.

distribution.en: Look in your ballot envelope. In the City of Northville, every absentee ballot comes with voting instructions and an "I Voted" sticker. Other clerks decide for themselves.
distribution.quote: Your ballot comes with complete voting instructions and an "I Voted" sticker.

story.en: Minnesota's I voted sticker is written into state law: it says "I VOTED," and nothing more. Election officials can give one to you when you put your ballot in the ballot box, and to people who vote by mail too.
story.es: El sticker de "I voted" de Minnesota está escrito en la ley estatal: dice "I VOTED", y nada más. Las autoridades electorales te pueden dar uno cuando metes tu boleta en la urna, y también a quienes votan por correo.
story.quote: The secretary of state, county auditor, municipal clerk, school district clerk, or an election judge may provide a sticker containing the words "I VOTED," and nothing more, to an individual who:

records.title: Three new I Voted designs
records.selection: Student contest, grades 6 to 12, 151 entries, one winner per category

story.en: In Boone County, high school students design the sticker. More than 40 students sent in over 70 designs. The one picked for the 2026 and 2027 elections is by Grace, an 11th grader at Rock Bridge High School.
story.es: En el condado de Boone, estudiantes de preparatoria diseñan el sticker. Más de 40 estudiantes enviaron más de 70 diseños. El elegido para las elecciones de 2026 y 2027 es de Grace, estudiante de 11.º grado de Rock Bridge High School.
story.quote: Over 40 high school students from across Boone County submitted over 70 designs, which were narrowed down to 5 finalists. ... The "I Voted" sticker design selected for the 2026-2027 elections was submitted by Grace, 11th Grade, Rock Bridge High School.

records.office: St. Louis Board of Election Commissioners

distribution.en: In the City of St. Louis, you can pick up an "I Voted" sticker on your way out, however you vote. Elsewhere, each election office sets its own practice.
distribution.quote: No matter what method you use to vote, you can pick up an "I Voted" sticker on your way out.

records.title: 2026 I Voted sticker contest
records.selection: Contest open to registered voters 18 and older; for all 82 counties

story.en: In 2025, Mississippi's Secretary of State held a contest for registered voters 18 and older to design the I Voted sticker for all 82 counties to use during the 2026 election cycle. Entries closed October 31, 2025.
story.es: En 2025, la Secretaría de Estado de Mississippi hizo un concurso para que los votantes registrados de 18 años o más diseñaran el sticker de "I Voted" que los 82 condados usarían durante el ciclo electoral de 2026. La inscripción cerró el 31 de octubre de 2025.
story.quote: All submissions are due by 5:00 p.m. on Friday, October 31, 2025. ... Anyone 18 years and older who is registered to vote in Mississippi is encouraged to design and submit artwork to be used as the "I Voted" sticker for all 82 counties during the 2026 election cycle .

records.title: 2026 I Voted sticker
records.office: Montana Secretary of State, with election officials from all 56 counties

story.en: Montana's Secretary of State unveiled a new I Voted sticker for the 2026 elections. It's red, white and blue, with an outline of the state and its mountains. Look for it at polling places and county election offices.
story.es: La Secretaría de Estado de Montana presentó un nuevo sticker de "I Voted" para las elecciones de 2026. Es rojo, blanco y azul, con la silueta del estado y sus montañas. Búscalo en los lugares de votación y en las oficinas electorales de los condados.
story.quote: Montanans will see the new sticker at polling places and in county election offices during the 2026 Primary and General Elections.

records.selection: Public vote, then the Board picks from the top three

story.en: Some North Carolina counties let residents help pick the sticker. Durham County ran a public contest for its 2026 "I Voted" sticker: residents voted in two rounds, and the county Board of Elections picked the winner from the top three at its August 13 meeting. The county says voters get the new design at polling places starting with this election.
story.es: Algunos condados de North Carolina dejan que los residentes ayuden a elegir el sticker. El condado de Durham hizo un concurso público para su sticker de "I Voted" de 2026: los residentes votaron en dos rondas, y la junta electoral del condado (Board of Elections) eligió al ganador entre los tres primeros en su reunión del 13 de agosto. El condado dice que los votantes reciben el nuevo diseño en los lugares de votación a partir de esta elección.
story.quote: Artists and residents are invited to create a fresh design that voters will receive at polling locations, beginning with the 2026 Statewide General Election. ... Thurs., August 13th Winner Selected at Board Meeting

distribution.en: In Guilford County, early voting officials hand you an "I Voted Early" sticker once your ballot has gone through the tabulator, and curbside voters get one at the car. Other counties choose their own stickers.
distribution.quote: Stickers should be handed out after the ballot has been successfully tabulated.

records.title: You Betcha I Voted
records.selection: First statewide contest; 478 entries; public vote

story.en: For 2026, the North Dakota Secretary of State's office held its first I Voted sticker contest. Haylee Senger of Bottineau designed the winner, "You Betcha I Voted." The contest drew 478 artists, and 4,792 North Dakotans voted to pick the winner. The sticker debuted at the June 9 primary.
story.es: Para 2026, la Secretaría de Estado de North Dakota hizo su primer concurso de stickers "I Voted". Haylee Senger, de Bottineau, diseñó el ganador, "You Betcha I Voted". Participaron 478 artistas, y 4,792 personas de North Dakota votaron para elegir al ganador. El sticker se estrenó en las primarias del 9 de junio.
story.quote: For the first time, the North Dakota Office of the Secretary of State held a contest to select a new “I Voted” sticker for the state. Haylee Senger from Bottineau submitted the winning “You Betcha I Voted” sticker design, which debuted at the polls during the 2026 Primary Election on June 9. ... Designs were submitted by 478 artists of all ages and skill levels from all corners of the state. Four finalists were selected and then 4,792 North Dakotans voted to decide the winner.

records.selection: County's first I Voted and Future Voter sticker contest

story.en: Lancaster County picked new “I Voted” and “Future Voter” stickers in its first sticker contest. Katie Nieland’s winning “I Voted” design has been available since the May 12, 2026 primary.
story.es: El condado de Lancaster eligió nuevos stickers de “I Voted” y “Future Voter” en su primer concurso de stickers. El diseño ganador de “I Voted”, de Katie Nieland, está disponible desde la primaria del 12 de mayo de 2026.
story.quote: Both stickers will be available beginning with the May 12, 2026, Primary Election.

records.title: Fourth and fifth grade I Voted sticker contest
records.selection: Student contest (grades 4 and 5); finalists chosen by the Secretary of State's office, winners by a panel of local election officials

story.en: New Hampshire's 2026 I Voted stickers were drawn by six fourth- and fifth-grade students from Milford, Windham, Lebanon, Chester, Etna and Nottingham. More than 2,800 students entered the Secretary of State's contest. The winners were announced November 13, 2025, and the designs are handed out statewide during the 2026 state elections.
story.es: Los stickers "I Voted" de New Hampshire para 2026 los dibujaron seis estudiantes de cuarto y quinto grado de Milford, Windham, Lebanon, Chester, Etna y Nottingham. Más de 2,800 estudiantes participaron en el concurso de la Secretaría de Estado. Los ganadores se anunciaron el 13 de noviembre de 2025, y los diseños se reparten en todo el estado durante las elecciones estatales de 2026.
story.quote: New Hampshire Secretary of State David Scanlan and Deputy Secretary of State Erin Hennessey are excited to announce the six winners of the 2025 “I Voted” Sticker Contest. The winning designs will be distributed statewide during the 2026 state elections. ... Over 2,800 fourth- and fifth-grade students participated in the contest, making it nearly impossible to choose just four winners, so the Secretary of State’s Office chose two additional winners.

records.title: Three winning designs
records.selection: Student contest, closed September 8

story.en: In Bernalillo County, students drew this year's I Voted stickers. The County Clerk and Albuquerque Public Schools asked K to 12 students for art on the theme "Voting Is Your Superpower." Out of 500 entries, 12 designs were picked, from elementary, middle and high school. They're the official stickers handed out across the county for the November 3 election.
story.es: En el condado de Bernalillo, estudiantes dibujaron los stickers de I Voted de este año. La secretaría del condado (County Clerk) y Albuquerque Public Schools pidieron a estudiantes de kínder a 12.º grado arte con el tema "Voting Is Your Superpower" (votar es tu superpoder). De 500 propuestas, se eligieron 12 diseños de primaria, secundaria y preparatoria. Son los stickers oficiales que se reparten en todo el condado para la elección del 3 de noviembre.
story.quote: The contest drew 500 submissions from APS students in grades K–12, with original artwork inspired by the theme "Voting Is Your Superpower." Twelve designs were selected, with four winners from each grade division. ... The twelve winning designs will serve as the official "I Voted" stickers for the 2026 General Election and will be distributed to voters throughout Bernalillo County.

records.title: I Voted Early, I Voted and Future Voter
records.selection: Student contest

distribution.en: In Los Alamos County, yes. The county's 2026 student contest included an "I Voted Early" sticker along with "I Voted" and "Future Voter." The county said the winners would be handed out at every county voting location this year.
distribution.quote: will be printed and distributed as official stickers at all Los Alamos County voting locations for the 2026 elections

story.en: For Election Day 2024, Allegiant Stadium was an official Clark County polling place, and voters who cast a ballot there got an "I VOTED" sticker made by the Las Vegas Raiders.
story.es: El Día de las Elecciones de 2024, el Allegiant Stadium fue un lugar de votación oficial del condado de Clark, y quienes votaron ahí recibieron un sticker de "I VOTED" hecho por los Las Vegas Raiders.
story.quote: Allegiant Stadium will serve as an official polling location for Clark County voters on Election Day, November 5th, 2024. The Las Vegas Raiders created an exclusive “I VOTED” sticker for voters who cast their ballot at Allegiant Stadium on Election Day.

distribution.en: In Clark County, the 2026 voter guide's in-person steps, for early voting and on Election Day, end with getting your "I Voted" sticker at the tabulator. Other counties set their own practice.
distribution.quote: Receive your “I Voted” sticker.

records.selection: Student contest, ages 9 to 18, sixth year; public vote on finalists

story.en: Ulster County's Board of Elections runs a student I Voted sticker contest, now in its sixth year. More than 300 students ages 9 to 18 sent in designs, and the public voted on six finalists. Bea, a 7th grader at Mountain Laurel Waldorf School, got the most votes. The county says the top design goes to all its voters on November 3, 2026.
story.es: La junta electoral del condado de Ulster (Board of Elections) organiza un concurso estudiantil de stickers de I Voted, que ya va en su sexto año. Más de 300 estudiantes de 9 a 18 años mandaron diseños, y el público votó entre seis finalistas. Bea, estudiante de 7.º grado de Mountain Laurel Waldorf School, sacó más votos. El condado dice que el diseño ganador se reparte a todos sus votantes el 3 de noviembre de 2026.
story.quote: The design with the most votes will be produced and distributed to all voters at the November 3, 2026 General Election. Special thanks to the more than 300 student artists that contributed designs this year! Bea Henry – Age 12, Mountain Laurel Waldorf School, 7th Grade 28.36%

distribution.en: In New York City, the city's 2026 general election guide tells voters at early voting and Election Day poll sites to pick up an official "I Voted" sticker before they leave. Other counties set their own practice.
distribution.quote: Don't forget to pick up an official "I Voted" sticker before you leave!

records.title: 2019 student I Voted sticker
records.selection: Contest for grades 6 to 12; three finalists; public vote

story.en: For 2026, the Secretary of State unveiled a limited-edition America 250 "I Voted" sticker for the nation's 250th birthday. Each of Ohio's 88 county boards of elections gets a limited supply for this election. Ohio's earlier sticker came from a 2019 contest for students, won by Emily, a senior at Teays Valley High School in Pickaway County.
story.es: Para 2026, la Secretaría de Estado presentó un sticker de "I Voted" de edición limitada de America 250 por los 250 años del país. Cada una de las 88 juntas electorales de condado de Ohio recibe una cantidad limitada para esta elección. El sticker anterior de Ohio salió de un concurso para estudiantes en 2019, que ganó Emily, estudiante de último año en Teays Valley High School, en el condado de Pickaway.
story.quote: Each of Ohio's 88 county boards of elections will receive a limited supply of the new stickers for use during the 2026 General Election.

distribution.en: Yes, while supplies last. If you vote in person, early or on Election Day, you get the America 250 "I Voted" sticker from your county's limited supply.
distribution.quote: Voters who cast a ballot in person during early voting or on Election Day will receive the commemorative sticker while supplies last.

distribution.en: Cuyahoga County's board of elections offers a digital I Voted! sticker for people who voted by mail. Save it and share it.
distribution.quote: Click the I Voted! sticker below, save it, and share it on your social media to show your fellow Ohioans that you voted by mail and made your voice heard!

story.en: For America's 250th birthday, the State Election Board brought out two limited-edition I Voted sticker designs for the June 16, 2026 election, at early voting sites and polling places across the state while supplies lasted. Ask your voting location which stickers it has, and get yours before you leave the election enclosure.
story.es: Por el cumpleaños 250 de Estados Unidos, la Junta Electoral del Estado (State Election Board) sacó dos diseños de edición limitada del sticker de "I Voted" para la elección del 16 de junio de 2026, en los lugares de votación anticipada y de votación de todo el estado mientras hubo. Pregunta en tu lugar de votación qué stickers tiene, y pide el tuyo antes de salir del área de votación.
story.quote: State Election Board Secretary Paul Ziriax announced that, “In honor of America’s 250th birthday, limited-edition ‘I Voted’ stickers will be available at early voting locations and polling places across the state, while supplies last.” There are two different designs.

story.en: Oregon votes by mail, so the Secretary of State offers two virtual stickers to download and share: "I Voted," with a checked ballot box on an Oregon-shaped flag, and "I Voted By Mail," with a signed ballot envelope.
story.es: Oregon vota por correo, así que la Secretaría de Estado ofrece dos stickers virtuales para descargar y compartir: "I Voted", con una casilla marcada sobre una bandera con la forma de Oregon, e "I Voted By Mail", con un sobre de boleta firmado.
story.quote: 2026 Elections Toolkit I Voted (virtual sticker) I Voted I Voted By Mail

records.title: Virtual I Voted sticker with BallotTrax tracking

distribution.en: In Multnomah County, sign up for ballot tracking at BallotTrax and you get a virtual "I Voted" sticker to share once your ballot is in. In another county? Ask your county elections office.
distribution.quote: You'll even receive a virtual "I Voted" sticker that's ready to share on social media.

records.title: I Voted N'at
records.selection: Student contest, public vote

story.en: Allegheny County's first I Voted sticker contest drew more than 13,000 public votes. The winner, I Voted N'at, by Molly, a 10th grader at Mt. Lebanon High School, is the county's sticker for the 2025 and 2026 elections.
story.es: El primer concurso de stickers I Voted del condado de Allegheny recibió más de 13,000 votos del público. El diseño ganador, I Voted N'at, de Molly, estudiante de 10.º grado de Mt. Lebanon High School, es el sticker del condado para las elecciones de 2025 y 2026.
story.quote: I Voted N'at design of "balancing civic duty and Pittsburgh pride" was printed for the 2025 and 2026 elections cycles in Allegheny County.

story.en: In Cranston, high school students design the city's I Voted stickers. The Board of Canvassers started the contest in 2025, reviewed 10 finalists picked by the School Department, and chose four 2026 designs, by Samantha, Lexi, Grace and Julia, for Cranston polling places.
story.es: En Cranston, estudiantes de preparatoria diseñan los stickers de "I Voted" de la ciudad. La junta de escrutinio (Board of Canvassers) creó el concurso en 2025, revisó 10 finalistas elegidos por el Departamento Escolar y escogió cuatro diseños de 2026, de Samantha, Lexi, Grace y Julia, para los lugares de votación de Cranston.
story.quote: The Board of Canvassers publicly reviewed 10 finalists from students, which were selected by the School Department, and selected designs to print in accordance with the contest policies. ... congratulations to those whose artwork was selected for use at Cranston polling places!

distribution.en: Yes. The Department of State's early voting steps end with returning the empty secrecy folder and wearing your "I voted" sticker.
distribution.quote: proudly wear your “I voted” sticker!

distribution.en: Yes. Rhode Island puts an "I Voted by Mail" sticker in every mail ballot packet, along with your ballot, the certificate envelope, the instructions and a postage-paid return envelope.
distribution.quote: Your mail ballot packet includes: Your mail ballot Voter's Mail Ballot Certificate envelope Vote by Mail instructions wrap Postage-paid return envelope I Voted by Mail sticker

records.office: Charleston County Board of Voter Registration and Elections
records.selection: Student contest

story.en: South Carolina's State Election Commission introduced two new statewide "I Voted" sticker designs for the 2022 elections, and they won a national Clearie Award from the U.S. Election Assistance Commission. Some counties add their own: Charleston County's 2026 stickers come from a student design contest.
story.es: La Comisión Electoral Estatal de South Carolina presentó dos nuevos diseños estatales de stickers de "I Voted" para las elecciones de 2022, y ganaron un premio nacional Clearie de la Comisión de Asistencia Electoral de EE. UU. (U.S. Election Assistance Commission). Algunos condados agregan los suyos: los stickers de 2026 del condado de Charleston salen de un concurso de diseño para estudiantes.
story.quote: The SEC’s new “I Voted” stickers also won a Clearie Award for exemplifying outreach and community flair.

distribution.en: In Charleston County, yes, for a limited time. Early voting centers and absentee voters get the 2026 student contest designs, by Emmeline (grades K to 5), Adalyn (6 to 8) and Katherine (9 to 12).
distribution.quote: Winning designs will be distributed for a limited time at all early voting centers and to our absentee voters this fall.

records.title: Civics in the 605 Statewide Sticker Showcase
records.selection: Student contest, kindergarten through 12th grade, four age groups

story.en: South Dakota students designed the 2026 I Voted stickers through the Secretary of State's Civics in the 605 Statewide Sticker Showcase. On February 17, 2026, the office named four winners from hundreds of entries: Owen of Vermillion Elementary School, Guenevere of Creekside Elementary in Spearfish, Allie of Rapid City Christian and Ashtyn of McCook Central High School. Their designs are handed out across the state for the November 3 election.
story.es: Estudiantes de South Dakota diseñaron los stickers "I Voted" de 2026 en el concurso Civics in the 605 Statewide Sticker Showcase de la Secretaría de Estado. El 17 de febrero de 2026, la oficina eligió a cuatro ganadores entre cientos de participantes: Owen, de Vermillion Elementary School; Guenevere, de Creekside Elementary en Spearfish; Allie, de Rapid City Christian; y Ashtyn, de McCook Central High School. Sus diseños se reparten en todo el estado para la elección del 3 de noviembre.
story.quote: Out of hundreds of entries from around South Dakota, the following students were selected as winners ... Grades K-2: Owen W. from Vermillion Elementary School • Grades 3-5: Guenevere W. from Creekside Elementary in Spearfish • Grades 6-8: Allie H. from Rapid City Christian • Grades 9-12: Ashtyn D. from McCook Central High School ... The winning entries will also be placed on stickers that will be handed out across South Dakota during the 2026 General Election on November 3rd, 2026.

story.en: For 2026, the Tennessee Secretary of State made a special America 250 I Voted sticker, with patriotic artwork for the country's 250th anniversary. The state said it would be at polling places during this year's elections.
story.es: Para 2026, la Secretaría de Estado de Tennessee hizo un sticker especial de I Voted por America 250, con arte patriótico por los 250 años del país. El estado dijo que estaría en los lugares de votación durante las elecciones de este año.
story.quote: The special America 250 sticker, which will be available at polling locations during upcoming elections, features patriotic artwork recognizing the nation's semiquincentennial and serves as a reminder of the enduring importance of civic engagement.

records.title: I Voted and Future Voter student designs
records.selection: Student contest (2025), first place in each category

story.en: In El Paso County, voters get student-designed stickers during the 2026 elections. Novalie, then a 10th grader at Eastwood High School, drew the I Voted sticker. Sophia, then a 4th grader at Coach Wally Hartley PK-8 School, drew the Future Voter sticker. They won first place in the county's 2025 sticker contest, out of 162 entries.
story.es: En el condado de El Paso, los votantes reciben stickers diseñados por estudiantes durante las elecciones de 2026. Novalie, que entonces cursaba 10.º grado en Eastwood High School, dibujó el sticker I Voted. Sophia, que entonces cursaba 4.º grado en Coach Wally Hartley PK-8 School, dibujó el sticker Future Voter. Ganaron el primer lugar en el concurso de stickers 2025 del condado, entre 162 diseños.
story.quote: First-place winning designs will be distributed to voters during the 2026 election season. ... “This year, we received 162 submissions compared to the 68 submissions for the last midterm election year.

distribution.en: In El Paso County, save a digital one. The county elections department posts a free digital "I Voted" sticker for mail voters: save the image to your phone or computer. In another county? Ask your county elections office.
distribution.quote: Digital Stickers Thank you for voting by mail! We still wanted to make sure you're able to celebrate casting your vote, so we've created a digital "I Voted" sticker. Save one of the images below on your phone or computer.

records.selection: A student's design

distribution.en: In Williamson County, yes, while supplies last. Its 2026 student-designed stickers are handed out from the first day of early voting, October 19, through Election Day, November 3. Austin, an eighth grader at Santa Rita Ranch Middle School, and Brinda, a 12th grader at Rouse High School, won first place in the I Voted contest. Felicity, a second grader at Naumann Elementary School, won first place for the Future Voter sticker.
distribution.quote: Winning sticker designs will be available in limited supply during voting, beginning with the first day of early voting on Oct. 19 and continuing through Election Day on Nov. 3, 2026. ... First place: Felicity, second grade, Naumann Elementary School (Leander ISD) ... First place: Austin, eighth grade, Santa Rita Ranch Middle School (Liberty Hill ISD) ... First place: Brinda, 12th grade, Rouse High School (Leander ISD)

story.en: For 2026, Weber County Elections held an America 250 "I Voted" sticker contest for local high school students. The winner is Hailey, a 10th grader at Ben Lomond High School, and her design goes to voters through the 2026 election cycle. Statewide, vote.utah.gov still offers four printable 2020 "I Voted" stickers.
story.es: Para 2026, la oficina electoral del condado de Weber organizó un concurso de stickers de "I Voted" de America 250 para estudiantes de preparatoria. La ganadora es Hailey, estudiante de 10.º grado en Ben Lomond High School, y su diseño se entrega a los votantes durante el ciclo electoral de 2026. A nivel estatal, vote.utah.gov todavía ofrece cuatro stickers de "I Voted" de 2020 para imprimir.
story.quote: Congratulations to Hailey, a 10th-grade student at Ben Lomond High School, whose design was chosen as this year's winning "I Voted" sticker!

distribution.en: Each locality picks its own sticker. In the City of Roanoke, limited America 250 "I Voted" stickers are handed out during early voting and at each precinct on Election Day.
distribution.quote: Limited quantities of America 250 "I Voted" stickers will be distributed during early voting and at each precinct on Election Day.

records.title: Student alternative I Voted sticker
records.office: Vermont Secretary of State (supports the contest)
records.selection: Yearly K-8 student contest; designs go to the winner's home district

story.en: Each year the Secretary of State's office supports a contest, part of the Good Citizen Challenge hosted by Seven Days, where K-8 students design an alternative "I Voted" sticker. Winning designs go to voters in the student's home district. The 2026 winner is Theo, of Burlington, and the runners-up are Penelope and Michael, also of Burlington. Burlington voters get their stickers on Election Day.
story.es: Cada año, la Secretaría de Estado apoya un concurso, parte del Good Citizen Challenge que organiza Seven Days, en el que estudiantes de kínder a 8.º grado diseñan un sticker alternativo de "I Voted". Los diseños ganadores se entregan a los votantes del distrito del estudiante. El ganador de 2026 es Theo, de Burlington, y los finalistas son Penelope y Michael, también de Burlington. Quienes votan en Burlington reciben sus stickers el Día de las Elecciones.
story.quote: The winning designs are distributed in the student’s home district. ... also of Burlington. Their designs can be viewed here and will be available to voters in Burlington on Election Day.

records.title: Seven new I Voted designs, one made with the Tulalip Tribes

story.en: Snohomish County has seven new I Voted designs for the November 3 election, showing the county's landscapes, industries and cultures. One was made with the Tulalip Tribes and reflects Coast Salish heritage. Once you've returned your ballot, you can get one at the Auditor's Office in Everett, any Sno-Isle Libraries location or an accessible voter services site, during their open hours.
story.es: El condado de Snohomish tiene siete diseños nuevos de sticker de "I Voted" para las elecciones del 3 de noviembre, con paisajes, industrias y culturas del condado. Uno se hizo junto con las Tribus Tulalip (Tulalip Tribes) y refleja la herencia cultural Coast Salish. Cuando ya hayas entregado tu boleta, puedes conseguir uno en la oficina del auditor en Everett (Auditor's Office), en cualquier biblioteca de Sno-Isle Libraries o en un centro accesible de servicios para votantes, en su horario de atención.
story.quote: one of Snohomish County’s new “I Voted” stickers, available at the Auditor’s Office in Everett, all Sno-Isle Libraries locations

distribution.en: Check your ballot packet first, since some counties put a sticker in it. Thurston County includes its "I Voted" sticker, by local artist Alexis Trono, in every ballot packet through the 2027 primary, this election included.
distribution.quote: be included in every ballot packet through the 2027 Primary Election, including the 2026 federal midterms

records.selection: Student contest, grades K-12; top four designs

story.en: Washington County’s clerk asked students in kindergarten through 12th grade to design the 2026 “I Voted” sticker. The top four designs were picked for the stickers at the November 3, 2026 general election.
story.es: La secretaría del condado de Washington invitó a estudiantes de kínder a 12.º grado a diseñar el sticker de “I Voted” de 2026. Los cuatro mejores diseños se eligieron para los stickers de la elección general del 3 de noviembre de 2026.
story.quote: printed and distributed to voters during the November 3, 2026 General Election

records.title: First statewide I Voted! sticker
records.selection: First statewide contest for eighth graders

story.en: West Virginia held its first statewide I Voted! sticker contest in 2026, and more than 1,100 eighth graders entered. Voters picked the statewide winner from four regional winners: a design by Reese, an eighth grader at Shady Spring Middle School in Raleigh County. Raleigh County's clerk received 11,000 of her stickers to hand out to in-person voters in the May primary.
story.es: West Virginia hizo su primer concurso estatal de stickers "I Voted!" en 2026, y participaron más de 1,100 estudiantes de octavo grado. Los votantes eligieron al ganador estatal entre cuatro ganadores regionales: un diseño de Reese, estudiante de octavo grado de Shady Spring Middle School, en el condado de Raleigh. El secretario del condado de Raleigh recibió 11,000 de sus stickers para repartirlos a quienes votaron en persona en las primarias de mayo.
story.quote: With the support of the state's county clerks, more than 1,100 eighth grade student artists entered the contest. ... Secretary Warner announced that Reese Childers, a student at Shady Spring Middle School in Raleigh County (her design is above), was selected by the voters to be the 2026 Statewide Winner. ... Raleigh County Clerk Scott Van Meter was presented with 11,000 stickers featuring Reese's design to be handed out to Raleigh County voters who vote in-person in the Primary Election.

records.title: 150th anniversary of women's suffrage I Voted sticker
records.selection: Contest for high school juniors and seniors and college students; county clerks to hand out the winners

story.en: In 2019, the Secretary of State's office ran an I Voted sticker contest for Wyoming high school juniors and seniors and college students, marking 150 years of women's suffrage in Wyoming. The rules said county clerks would hand out the stickers at polling places during early voting and on Election Day.
story.es: En 2019, la Secretaría de Estado hizo un concurso de stickers "I Voted" para estudiantes de penúltimo y último año de preparatoria y estudiantes universitarios de Wyoming, por los 150 años del voto femenino en Wyoming. Las reglas decían que los secretarios de condado (county clerks) repartirían los stickers en los lugares de votación durante la votación anticipada y el Día de las Elecciones.
story.quote: 150th Anniversary ... The contest is open to students enrolled in a Wyoming high school (Junior or Senior) or a Wyoming college. ... The Wyoming County Clerks will be distributing the stickers at polling places during Early Voting and on Election Day.
